content: Scarlet Skips (Steam appid 4513480, Yerk Games, 2026-09-03): official facts are 10 upgrade cards, pick 1 of 3 at each level-up, example effects jump-height/add-rope/set-on-fire. Community-identified cards: Increase Jump Height (blue/feet, safety-margin), Add Jump Rope (score volume), Ignite Jump Rope (red, risk, flame multiplier), Reinforce Jump Rope (maintenance; stops being offered when all ropes reinforced), Upgrade Rocket Fuel (purple, airtime foundation, stacked early), Increase Jump Rope Speed (green, late-game pace card), Increase Luck (green clover, effect undocumented, 'LUCKY' banner), plus an unnamed extinguish card (trap/buggy). Cards stack multiplicatively; rope-count x height x flame multiplier; speed early kills runs.
